body:
Store verified project facts as Lore memories, multi-layer explanations as architecture notes, reusable approaches as patterns and operational traps as hotfixes. Cite stable Docsync definitions in the public explanation and commit the shared Lore JSON with it. This makes future code changes expose stale explanatory claims through task check, instead of leaving knowledge only in a completed conversation.

Evidence: ds:block?id=gate-9g2wphfm; ds:block?id=promise-gate-a57aksdv. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: Persist explanations with their code references
